entities.summary: Leo Karl Borg is a Swedish tennis player. He has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 334 achieved on 11 September 2023 and a doubles ranking of No. 1,033 achieved on 26 June 2023. He is the current No. 3 Swedish singles player.
